- Initial release of the anyone-proxy skill.
- Enables IP address masking and access to hidden services via the Anyone Network.
- Sets up a local SOCKS5 proxy server (default port: 9050) using @anyone-protocol/anyone-client.
- Routes traffic through encrypted circuits to hide the origin IP.
- Includes setup and usage instructions for both command line and JavaScript.
